answer: On-ledger coin taint makes a caught Sybil ring forfeit what it already earned, not only its future income. Every coin records the seat that mined it. When a jury convicts a cluster of clones, say seats sonnet and dune plus 38 siblings, all their coins are flagged on-ledger, and merchants, swap desks and bridges refuse them. The flag follows transfers for 5 hops and taints any pot it is mixed into, so relay wallets cannot launder it. If each fake earns 25 POA per epoch, a 40-seat forge holds 1,000 POA hostage per epoch, and each added fake puts its own 25 POA at risk.
